commands.fingerprint_scope: Root 2.0 src, examples/vite, tests, tools, README, LICENSE, package/lock and TS/Vitest configuration. Installed dependencies and browser binaries are identified by lock/runtime/consumer records; preserved v1 benchmark inputs remain unchanged against HEAD.
commands.note: Every final gate matches the same frozen input map. The earlier sixteen passing gates precede the last equivalent compiled-control-index change and certify only that provisional candidate. Final generated compiler output is archived once and that exact archive is installed in every JS/TS/browser consumer. Failed/superseded attempts are retained, never counted as certification of final inputs.

infrastructure_failure.response: No source, test, assertion, timeout or budget change; rerun complete required suites sequentially after browser activity stopped. Read-only TCP counts did not establish the OS cause.

checks.example_types: pass; Node Vite config/mock server excluded
checks.installed_lifecycle: Inclusive status projection and protected tombstones, input-only defaults with application factories, explicit refresh, owned synchronous row hooks, clean loaded append and authored empty markup alongside all preceding CVC/control/block/column/viewport assertions.

blocks.merge: Adjacent scalar group keys span complete two-row records; each native merge stays inside a consecutive mounted segment.

method.timing: Rows and authored HTML prepared outside timing. Each operation includes two successive stable animation-frame geometry observations; fail after fifteen frames.
method.focus: One invalid draft editor remains pinned with its exact node and caret while a distant variable-height window renders.
method.paste: Flat/nested paste one thousand offscreen records; blocks paste one hundred. Each changes two fields in one atomic event; nested detail uses numeric Select values.
method.move: Move the last of five thousand stored rows before a stable row near the current window; one event, unchanged snapshot and pinned draft/caret. Includes settled DOM with a 100ms same-host Chromium median budget.

append.operation: After original operations and twenty scroll-cycle assertions, append 250 clean records in one event. Preserve every old snapshot/order, save changes, checks, focused node/draft/caret and scroll anchor. Dispose all 5,250 records under the original cleanup budget.

method.geometry: Every live checkpoint requires intersecting mounted data rows and different measured row heights; reveal verifies the complete requested record rectangle and forward scroll advances logical intersection. Blocks record native physical-row heights, record bounds and merge spans; twenty cycle windows record actual intersections.
method.cleanup: Exact authored markup/style after disposal, then observe zero mutations across late scroll and stable frames; this observes quiet work, not a direct cancelAnimationFrame call.
method.memory: Chromium CDP forces GC before DOM counters; twenty-cycle growth remains bounded by two viewport element counts and twenty listeners. After detaching the fixture, record native focus/selection retention, release it by focusing the existing external main and clearing document ranges, wait two frames, then require the stated pre-fixture cleanup budget. No JavaScript heap-retention claim.
method.budgets: Host-relative Chromium medians declared before measurement; other engines report samples without applying Chromium thresholds.

performance.limits: Same-host completed DOM operations in Chromium; no universal speed, actual token or JavaScript heap-retention claim. Original fixture sizes, operations, warmups, samples and budgets remain intact; append runs last, adds 250 clean records, and teardown covers 5,250.

review.baseline: Read-only audit reproduced all 155 prior normalized sources, 42 log hashes, sixteen final gates and the exact 168-member preceding archive. No historical runtime rerun or provisional archive reconstruction was claimed.
review.source: Independent complete-change review exercised connected status/default/hook/append/empty flows before final gates; independent acceptance tests cover real failure, reentry, focus, MDI and cleanup cases.
corrections: Stop rollback after hook-triggered disposal so restored authored ARIA is untouched.

Keep forced selection/check prune notices after row-binding failure, exactly once. Defer failed-view notices until all projection/option rollback finishes so callbacks cannot have newer appended views overwritten.
Read merge status from current Rows, independent of invalidated binding caches.
Capture focus before selection pruning and move disabled retained controls to an enabled control or table fallback.
Capture/restore native disabled state before the before-row hook, preserve live customizations and enforce tombstone protection after both hook phases.
Capture native defaults individually; reject ambiguous/overlapping paths only when requested, and consume rejected asynchronous parser results.
review.contracts: Existing original-valued tombstones and deletion payloads remain unchanged. Legacy edited-deletion display, per-field dirty presentation and scheduler-option semantic equivalence remain explicit P0 obligations; no omission or full parity is approved. M13 whole-code review/remediation remains a future required gate.

limits: Only the contracted M10.9.4 slice is completed; detail/height, remaining framework parity, P0 semantic/dynamic closure and M13 are still required.
Actual macOS/iOS Safari is excluded; manual assistive technology, OS IME/clipboard, personal acceptance and fixed final agent-task/token evaluation remain unverified.
No npm publication, release tags, master/v1 changes or new feature omission.
